kanto.flavorText: The pressurized water jets on this brutal POKéMON’s shell are used for high- speed tackles.

original-johto.flavorText: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.

hoenn.flavorText: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

updated-johto.flavorText: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

updated-unova.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
